ICPR SPONSORED THREE DAYS NATIONAL SEMINER On Theory of Knowledge: Indian and Western Philosophical Perspectives Sessional Examination from 08-10-2025 Previous Next About Us Batadraba is an important place, the very birth place of Srimanta Sankardeva, the father figure of the Assamese culture, Education, and nationality. The college is established in the glowing memory of Srimanta Sankar Deva by the grateful people of this part of Assam. The college is only a Degree Arts College imparting general education to the students of higher learning of the greater locality of Batadraba set-up in 1989 last. The college has a good plot of its own land measuring 45 bighas alloted to it by the Govt. of Assam. Situated away from the ... Read More Prospectus Admission Courses Library Staff Login LMS From Principal's Desk Dr Namita Kalita Hon'ble Principal It gives me immense pleasure to pen a few words for our esteemed institution, Batadraba Sri Sri Sankardev College, a beacon of knowledge, culture, and community service nestled in the sacred land of Mahapurush Srimanta Sankardev. This college was founded under the visionary leadership of Bhugeswar Bora, whose dedication, sacrifice and dream to empower rural youth through education continue to inspire us. Today, as we walk on the path paved by such a noble soul, our responsibility is to preserve and enhance the values he stood for sincerity, knowledge and service. As the Principal of this institution, I take immense pride in the achievements of our students, faculty and alumni. We have not only excelled in academics but have also made a mark in research, cultural preservation, skill development and social outreach. Our faculty members are dedicated and student-centric, committed to both traditional wisdom and modern pedagogies.
